qpsDefinitions.requestQps: all JTL sample starts / (last start - first start); HTTP sampler start, not NIC wire timestamp
qpsDefinitions.httpCompletionQps: HTTP responses only / (last sample completion - first start); excludes connection errors
qpsDefinitions.finalPaidTps: unique PAID orders / (last recorded paid_at - first HTTP start); paid_at is transaction-record time, not commit timestamp
qpsDefinitions.fullRunPaidTps: unique PAID / (confirmed drain observation - first HTTP start)

drainMeasurement: upper bound to first post-HTTP observer confirming all requests/receipts succeeded, or final committed reconciliation snapshot
